description: Label merges applied to the ANNOTATION column before training and to ground-truth files before evaluation. Keys are raw labels, values are model classes; labels not listed are used as they are, and a label mapped to a name that is not a model class is scored as outside the model. A training run saves the copy it used, and prediction applies the copy in the model folder. The map is empty for the released model, whose training labels already carried its class names; to merge labels of your own data, add entries such as "B-ALL_BCR-ABL1": "B-ALL_PAX5_BCR-ABL1_BCR-ABL1-Like". Edit this file, not the code, to change the class scheme.
